name: Coordinate-State Recognition of the Complete Basis
statement: An irredundant finite partial cube $O$ with at least two vertices is a pc-minimal obstruction exactly when the original family has no peripheral coordinate and every feasible nonidentity full minor state with at least two vertices exposes a peripheral coordinate.
proof: Full states encode every sequence of restrictions and contractions, up to deletion of constant coordinates. The two conditions therefore say exactly that $O$ is periphery-free and every proper nontrivial pc-minor belongs to $\mathcal R_{\mathrm{per}}$.
